title: doctor counts the registry lines written at schema v1 apart from the other invalid lines, so an upgrade shows what the new log ignores
source: intended: docs/decisions.md registry v2 decision (defect N-31)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-31, owner answer A6). The registry log is schema v2 and a v1 line is skipped, so the registry check warns with the number of v1 lines it skipped, in its own clause, so the upgrade note can say `jitso doctor` counts them. A project whose only line is a v1 launch line has no launch and no running one. The oracle has no `doctor` command: it answers `unknown command "doctor"` on stderr with exit 2 and prints nothing on stdout, so the pinned line FAILS on it.

stdout.contains: warn registry: .jitso/launches.jsonl: 0 launches, 0 running; 1 v1 line skipped (written before the log moved to v: 2)
